tools.name: site_overview
tools.description: What this site is, key facts, menu sections and languages (the llms.txt).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category page of one language with its slug and one-line description. Use the slug in get_category and list_online.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Markdown of one category page: text, which platforms run it, how many models are online, related categories.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Markdown of one model page: status (online/offline, viewers), platform, languages, statistics, tags, the sign-up link.

tools.name: list_online
tools.description: Models live right now, most viewers first. category narrows to one category slug, nickname finds one model, limit (1-100, default 20) and page page through.
